set.acceptance: A test with fake operations and a fake exec drives each action and asserts the call it makes: o calls inbox.open with the item ID; an answer typed on a question calls session.message to its session with the typed text, and t sends the recommendation; y on a sign-off calls inbox.approve, c with text calls inbox.request-changes with it; R on a failed run calls run.resume with <run> --retry, and on a gave-up or skipped run calls run.resume with <run>, with no rex window new; x then y calls run.abandon, x then n calls nothing; no test runs real Rex or an agent
set.statement: On the selected inbox item: enter or o focuses its Rex tab (inbox open); on a question, typing an answer and enter sends it to the asking session as a message (session message), or t takes the advisor's recommendation; on a sign-off, y approves it and c asks for changes with typed findings; on a failed, gave-up or skipped run, R queues its retry through run.resume for the daemon to drive (a failed run with --retry, restarting at the step that failed) and x abandons it after a y/n; each action reloads the list
